messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

set: ["Tonmya sublingual tablets taken once a day", "Tonmya sublingual tablets", "Tonmya sublingual tablets (fibromyalgia)", "taken once a day", "immediate-release tablets taken three times a day", "taken once or twice a day", "taken as one dose once a day", "Amrix extended-release capsules taken once a day", "taken twice a day", "once a day", "Tonmya", "usually taken once per day", "usually taken once a day in the evening", "take once a day", "eight 50 mg tablets a day", "taken once daily"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
